notes.title: Update Notice of Version 1.07EA of 《PUZZLED HEROES》
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34709999/269cf8bcfe94010770ae92ee70ddda4d4f4215d2.jpg[/img]
Specific updates:
1: Cancel the second confirmation of ""MEDITATE"" and "DEFEND" in battle.
2: Restoration triggers BUG against the dead target in Barnassa's talent.
3: Repair the BUG that triggers the talent effect when “Garve”releases spell skills.
4: Adjust the movement of characters and attack speed to 1.3 times of the original.
5: Improve the damage of some skills to make their damage more reasonable.
6: When the character moves, click on the ground to display the position cursor.
7: Add the functions of "game settings", "return to the start interface" and "exit the game" by pressing ESC in the game.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34709999/77c536b80018e0ef6c4d6c8782e6eb2b1db2a50f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update Notice of Version 1.06EA of 《PUZZLED HEROES》
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34709999/269cf8bcfe94010770ae92ee70ddda4d4f4215d2.jpg[/img]
In order to solve these problems, we have updated some functions and combat mechanisms. At the same time, in order to maintain the difficulty of some hard-core players, we maintain the original mode in the difficult mode and adjust the simple and ordinary mode of combat mechanism.

《PUZZLED HEROES》 production team is very grateful for the comments you have given us during this period, and please wait patiently for us to give the best game experience, hoping that you can actively feedback on the deficiencies in the game.

Specific updates:
1: Repair Fire Attribute Slim with blue adjusted to red
2: Repairing the Mobile Attacks of Inmovable Objects such as Cannibals, Flowers and Wood Piles 
3: Repair some of the monsters in the sequence of action does not show the head problem.
4: Repair the monster's action sequence and victory condition to display the problem at different resolutions.
5: Added 1600*900 Resolution
6: Modify the difficulty of checkpoints, adjust some of the checkpoints friendly AI, resulting in unfriendly problems such as blockage of players.
7: Adjusting the number of equipment reinforcement shows that the equipment can be upgraded several times.
8: Adjust the speed of cannibalism summoned by summoning instrument to 48, 56 skills to poison.
9: Remove the skill book items, and automatically learn the skills of the corresponding level when the skill level is raised.
10: Simple and ordinary difficulty level only when all players are killed in battle
Difficulties remain unchanged, and any character who dies in battle fails. (Some special requirements remain unchanged)
11: New content: Some stories after "Lorian" departure will be updated in the next few days.
12:Repair Unable to choose difficult mode

notes.title: Update Announcement of 1.05EA Version of 《PUZZLED HEROES》
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34709999/269cf8bcfe94010770ae92ee70ddda4d4f4215d2.jpg[/img]

We have recently focused on optimizing some of the game's user-friendly functions, this time more detailed content.
Feedback from STEAM community or QQ group if you have any questions.
Thank you again for your support. Some of the new content is expected to be released in the next version. Please keep an eye on us!

Specific version updates:
1: Repair the experience bug that does not increase the armor in the training field
2: Fix the problem that the name on the left of the world map cannot be switched by clicking
3: No refresh of knapsack attributes when repairing equipment is unloaded
4:Infinite trigger battle when repairing escape from Iwate Castle
5: Speed up the display of text slightly in conversation
6: Repair NPC blockage, NPC no longer moves to the portal
7: Reduce the weight of part of the Artifact
8: Increase difficulty adjustment, currently support three difficulties, simple, ordinary, difficult. When setting the interface, you can choose the difficulty, the original default difficulty is ordinary. New start will also ask the difficulty choice.
9: Repairing the problem of the East Gate after the solitary bandits joined the ranks
10:Increase the display of victory conditions in battle, and you can view victory conditions at any time in battle.
11:Increase the role switching in the scene movement, and other roles can be switched to lead the team in the scene.
Click on the left role header box to switch, and the user of the handle press the left rocker to switch.
12: Add the role attribute description, add TIPS flag in the role attribute panel, and click to see the role of the attribute.
13:Increase the sequence of action in battle and display the list of three roles in the next round to facilitate players to understand the sequence of follow-up actions.
14:Modify the description of the main line log of rescuing refugees from slums. Many players can't complete the response task because they didn't talk to the second male refugee.
15:Adjust the description of the magic task about the investigation of the grottoes and ask the aunt to modify the name of the village. Prevent the player from mistakenly thinking that it is impossible to find the aunt to update the task.
16: Adjusting part of the spell rank affects the effect of the spell (spell hits, spell values, etc.).

As for the display of action sequence, show a round of objects. When a new round of action sequence is re-displayed after the end of a round of action, note that when a role can act, it directly chooses standby and does not consume attack instructions, he will restore part of the speed value as compensation, so that it can take priority action in the next round.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34709999/77c536b80018e0ef6c4d6c8782e6eb2b1db2a50f.jpg[/img]
